# Orchestration, Autonomy, Approval, and Reliability Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System — URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the orchestration requirements (domains 4 Agentic orchestration, 5 Controlled autonomy, 6 Human approvals, 9 Reliability and recovery)
**Created**: 2026-09-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Tags**: `[Mandatory]` / `[Enhancement]`; `Detects:` names the guide failure trap an item guards against.

## Agentic Orchestration

- [ ] CHK001 Is the plan specified as an explicit dependency graph (stages plus dependencies) rather than an ordered list of steps? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-02, Plan §3] Detects: linear chaining disguised as orchestration. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the graph template specify at least two fan-out points and two synchronization points? [Coverage, Plan §3 stage graph template] Detects: missing synchronization. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Is join behavior specified for a failed predecessor (the join never starts)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-ORC-05] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Is every conditional branch specified with its condition and the skip reason that must be recorded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-ORC-06, Plan §3] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Does every stage specify inputs, outputs, entry and exit criteria, actor, timeout, retry policy, failure classification, fallback, side effects, and audit events? [Completeness, Plan §3 stage specifications, Constitution II] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK006 Are allowed and prohibited transitions defined for both the run and stage state machines? [Completeness, data-model.md §State machines, Spec §FR-ORC-11] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK007 Is state persistence required at every transition, with "persist before side effect" ordering specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-ORC-08, ADR-006] Detects: missing persistent state. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the dependency representation persisted and versioned with diffs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-RPL-02, ADR-007] Detects: missing dependency representation. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Is cross-stage context specified as versioned artifacts with provenance (stage, attempt, inputs, fingerprint)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-10, data-model.md Artifact] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Is decision lineage specified so that any artifact can be traced to the decisions and inputs that produced it? [Completeness, Spec §FR-AUD-03, Plan §4] Detects: missing decision lineage. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK011 Are replanning triggers, invalidation scope, the reuse rule, and plan-diff recording all specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-RPL-01/02, ADR-011] Detects: missing dynamic replanning. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK012 Is it specified which stages must not re-execute after an upstream change and how that is decided? [Clarity, Spec §FR-RPL-01, ADR-011] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK013 Is replanning of terminal runs explicitly prohibited? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-RPL-05] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK014 Is late-ambiguity handling specified to suspend only the dependent paths? [Coverage, Spec §FR-RPL-06] [Mandatory]

## Controlled Autonomy

- [ ] CHK015 Are each agent's permitted actions enumerated, with the refusal, audit, and failure class for out-of-scope actions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-12, §NFR-AUT-01, ADR-017] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the autonomy budget quantified (attempts, processing time) with its exhaustion behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-ORC-18, PVT-17] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK017 Is it specified that agents cannot decide gates, change policies, or release capabilities outside the release stage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-12] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the maximum parallelism of agent execution bounded and documented as a requirement? [Gap, Plan §3 bounded pool] [Enhancement]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the behavior defined when the implementation stage cannot find the capability in the running system? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-ORC-15, Constitution X] Detects: fabricated results. [Mandatory]

## Human Approvals

- [ ] CHK020 Is every high-impact action mapped to a gate with required role, separation-of-duties rule, deadline, and approve/reject outcomes? [Completeness, Plan §5, Spec §FR-GOV-01] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK021 Is it specified that absence of a response never approves, with a defined timeout outcome? [Clarity, Spec §FR-GOV-07, Constitution III] Detects: approval inferred from silence. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK022 Are anti-bypass guarantees specified at the API, engine, and code-structure levels? [Completeness, Plan §5, ADR-008] Detects: missing approval enforcement. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK023 Is approval binding to artifact fingerprints specified, including the outcome when bound content changes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-GOV-05, ADR-008] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK024 Is concurrent decision handling specified (exactly one decision wins)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, ADR-006] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the release gate specified to refuse approval while readiness is `NOT READY`, re-evaluated at decision time? [Clarity, Spec §FR-RDY-02] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the role allowed to answer clarification questions defined, or explicitly flagged as deferred? [Ambiguity, Spec §AMB-11, §ASM-11] [Mandatory]

## Reliability and Recovery

- [ ] CHK027 Is failure classification defined, with retry eligibility limited to transient failures? [Clarity, Spec §FR-REL-01, Plan §6] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK028 Are retry bounds and backoff quantified per stage, with no unbounded path? [Measurability, Spec §FR-REL-01, PVT-11] Detects: unlimited retries. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK029 Is timeout behavior specified, including treatment of late results? [Completeness, Spec §FR-REL-02] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK030 Are fallbacks defined per stage, explicitly excluded for verification stages, with degradation visible downstream? [Completeness, Spec §FR-REL-03, ADR-009] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK031 Is rollback claimed only for state fully under system control, with every side effect mapped to rollback or compensation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-REL-05, ADR-010] Detects: invalid rollback claims. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK032 Is compensation specified for every side-effecting stage, including ordering and failure handling? [Completeness, Spec §FR-REL-04, §FR-REL-10] Detects: missing compensation. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK033 Are all safe-stop triggers enumerated and the safe-stop procedure specified step by step? [Completeness, Spec §FR-REL-06, Plan §6] Detects: missing safe-stop. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK034 Is resumption after a process restart specified, including interrupted attempts and waiting gates? [Completeness, Spec §FR-REL-08, Plan §6] Detects: missing resume behavior. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK035 Is duplicate-execution protection specified (attempt identity, idempotent side effects)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-REL-09] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the behavior of sibling branches specified when one parallel branch fails permanently? [Edge Case, Plan §6 partial failure] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK037 Is orchestration behavior specified when the persistence store itself is unavailable? [Edge Case, Plan §6 dependency unavailability] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK038 Is fault injection specified as disabled by default and labeled as simulated wherever it appears? [Clarity, Spec §FR-REL-11, Constitution V and X] [Mandatory]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
